content.text: In today's digital economy, many creators are locked out of essential payment processing systems like Stripe and PayPal, particularly in Zimbabwe. This exclusion hampers your ability to sell digital products effectively. However, with the right infrastructure, you can build and operate a fully functional online store without relying on these conventional platforms. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-20|deploying]] your digital commerce stack on Cloudflare Pages, empowering you with complete control over your sales and customer relationships. Say goodbye to payment rejections and unexpected fees; it's time to take charge of your digital storefront with confidence.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often overlook creators in regions like Zimbabwe, leaving you with limited options. By leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can bypass these barriers. The Edge Commerce Stack combines Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-10|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-11|The Real]] is not just a workaround; it's a robust solution that places you in control. Your digital storefront operates independently, ensuring you maintain full ownership and access to your data. Even in an environment where conventional platforms fail, this infrastructure guarantees reliability and performance. You can process payments and deliver products without worrying about the restrictions imposed by third-party services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store, ensure you have the essential components ready. First, create a Cloudflare account and set up a domain or subdomain for your store. You'll also need a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will handle your backend logic efficiently. Prepare your digital products for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Lastly, documentation is key; have your product descriptions and marketing materials ready to go. This foundation will streamline the deployment process, allowing you to focus on configuring your store and driving sales.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your foundational components in place, begin configuring your payment and delivery system. Start by creating a new Cloudflare Pages project, linking it to your GitHub repository where your store's code will reside. Next, implement Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery. Write the necessary script to connect with NOWPayments, ensuring that it can trigger actions when a payment is confirmed on-chain. This setup allows for secure, automatic delivery of digital products after payment completion. Don't forget to test this process thoroughly in a secure environment before going live to ensure everything functions seamlessly.
Take control of your sales with independent infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Now that your infrastructure is set up, it's time to launch your digital store. Publish your Cloudflare Pages project and ensure your domain is properly configured. Announce your store's launch to your audience through social media and email channels. To process your first transaction, simulate a purchase using a crypto wallet compatible with NOWPayments. Monitor the entire process, from payment confirmation to product delivery, to identify any potential issues. This initial transaction will provide valuable insights into the customer experience and operational flow. Make adjustments as necessary, and prepare to scale up your efforts.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational and you've processed initial transactions, consider how to scale effectively. Analyze sales data to understand customer preferences and adjust your product offerings accordingly. You can integrate more digital products into your store without significant overhead. Leverage social media for targeted marketing campaigns, driving traffic to your storefront. As you grow, ensure your backend infrastructure can handle increased traffic by optimizing your Google Apps Script and leveraging Cloudflare Workers efficiently. Additionally, consider expanding your payment options within the NOWPayments ecosystem to cater to a broader audience. This scalable approach will position your digital store for long-term success.

By utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack, you gain access to free tools that allow you to host, process payments, and deliver products without traditional platform restrictions. This infrastructure enables you to take control of your sales effectively.

Priced at $197, this stack includes all necessary components for deployment, ensuring you can operate your store independently and effectively. With this system, you are not just using a platform; you are building your infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Cloudflare account and set up your domain. 2. Sign up for NOWPayments and configure your payment settings. 3. Prepare your digital products and documentation. 4. Set up a Cloudflare Pages project linked to your GitHub repository. 5. Use Google Apps Script to handle backend order processing. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. 7. Test the payment and delivery process thoroughly. 8. Announce your store's launch and promote it on social media. 9. Monitor transactions and customer experience for continuous improvement. 10. Optimize and scale your offerings as your store grows.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Edge Commerce Stack is a comprehensive toolset for deploying a digital store using Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. It allows creators to manage their online sales independently.
How do I set up NOWPayments?
To set up NOWPayments, create an account on their website, configure your payment settings, and integrate their API into your Google Apps Script for seamless transaction processing.
Can I use any cryptocurrency?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various digital currencies without any additional setup.
What if I encounter issues during deployment?
If you face challenges while deploying, consult the documentation provided with the Edge Commerce Stack or reach out for support to troubleshoot specific issues.
Is there a fee for using the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is priced at $197, and there are no ongoing subscription fees. You only pay a small transaction fee to NOWPayments.
